title: Normalized additive Cech comparison systems
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U=(U_i)_{i\in I}$ a covering of $X$. A normalized Cech comparison system consists of natural additive maps $c^q:\check H^q(U,-)\to H^q(X,-)$ on all abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], for every $q\geq0$. In degree zero the map is gluing followed by the inverse Ext-to-sections identification. For every short exact sequence of abelian sheaves which is surjective on sections over every tuple intersection, require $c^{q+1}\circ\check\delta^q=\delta^q\circ c^q$. For any $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ and module $M$, define its additive scalar-restricted map by transporting the homology of the complex of [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] to the Cech cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf and applying $c^q$. Transport uses the identity on underlying section groups, the proved categorical-to-explicit Cech homology isomorphism, and functoriality of homology. No system is chosen by this definition.
